description: This is a Java Spring MVC Controller class that manages user-related web requests such as displaying user forms, saving user data, editing and deleting users, listing roles, and changing passwords.

classes.name: UserController
classes.description: A Spring Controller handling user management web endpoints such as creating, editing, deleting users, listing roles, and changing passwords.

methods.name: showUserForm
methods.description: Renders the user creation form within the post-login content page.

methods.name: saveUser
methods.description: Handles form submission to create or update a user, then redirects to the user list.

methods.name: editUser
methods.description: Fetches a user by id and renders their data in a form for editing.

methods.name: deleteUser
methods.description: Deletes a user identified by id and redirects to the user list.

methods.name: list
methods.description: Provides a list of authority roles for form selection.

methods.name: getUser
methods.description: Allows the authenticated user to change their password after verifying the old password.
